visualCharacteristics: Coloured band (leafgreen by default) with the page h1 and a lead paragraph centred in the page grid, optional CTA and optional lead image below on a band-to-white gradient.

contentPattern.structure: optional short eyebrow paragraph, h1 title, lead paragraphs, optional bold CTA link, optional desktop and mobile pictures

usage: Page title band for static, listing and article pages.
reuseGuidance: Use at the top of non-landing pages; for a slide hero use page-hero-carousel.
